memory.scope: Owned native application and all discovered WebView2 descendants, no studio; excludes synthetic Node server and QA tools
memory.interpretation: One short sample per binary; inventory only, no statistically established memory improvement

notificationReady.scope: Seven warm renderer observations, including loopback dispatch and next-rAF sampling; rich phase settled, content interactive and opacity >= .95; not cold startup or DWM presentation
notificationReady.interpretation: Medians differ by less than one observed 60 Hz rAF interval; not a cold-start or DWM latency guarantee

qaEndpointReady.interpretation: One QA-enabled process launch per binary; endpoint readiness, not normal startup or content visibility

sourceContentTiming: NOT_RUN: secondary source WebView is not exposed through this owned CDP endpoint
